title: Measuring Optimal Transport in Transformer Depth
abstract: arXiv:2609.00748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A transformer carries each token's state from layer to layer, and the whole vocabulary carried together forms a cloud that moves with depth. We ask whether a trained network moves this cloud the way optimal transport would: at the cheapest cost, and along the map that pairs each token with its optimal destination. We measure both on Pythia-160m and Pythia-410m, with an exact assignment between consecutive layer clouds, a measured sampling floor, calibration on couplings known to be optimal, and a split of the cost into the common shift of the cloud and the token-specific moves. At the last layer, both models move their tokens where the optimal-transport map sends them, at the optimal cost for Pythia-410m and slightly above it for Pythia-160m. At the first layer they do not. translated_title: 测量Transformer深度中的最优传输
translated_abstract: Transformer将每个词元的状态从一层传递到另一层，整个被传递的词汇表共同形成一朵随深度移动的“云”。我们探究训练好的网络是否以最优传输的方式移动这朵云：即以最低的成本，并沿着将每个词元与其最优目的地配对的映射进行。我们在Pythia-160m和Pythia-410m上对这两个方面进行了测量，采用相邻层云之间的精确分配、实测的采样下限、对已知最优耦合的校准，并将成本分解为云的整体共同平移和词元特定的移动。在最后一层，两个模型都将词元移动到了最优传输映射所指定的位置，其中Pythia-410m达到了最优成本，Pythia-160m则略高于最优成本。而在第一层则并非如此。在中间层，十个层间转换中仅有两个可以仅凭成本来评判单个层，而多个层组成的块则以接近最优的成本移动这朵云。
tldr: 该研究首次在Pythia模型上量化验证了Transformer逐层移动词元表示“云”的方式符合最优传输：最后一层的移动达到最优传输映射与最优成本（Pythia-410m完全最优），第一层则不符合，而多层块整体以接近最优的成本移动表示云。
en_tdlr: This work provides the first quantitative measurement showing that trained transformers move their token-representation cloud across depth in accordance with optimal transport — matching the optimal map and cost at the last layer (fully optimal for Pythia-410m), failing at the first layer, with multi-layer blocks moving the cloud at near-optimal cost.
